H5416J.name: Nathan
H5416J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5416J.brief: Son of Attai, from the tribe of Judah.
H5416J.short: Nathan, the son of Attai, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H5416I.name: Nathan
H5416I.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H5416I.brief: One of David's mighty men, brother of Joel.
H5416I.short: Nathan, the brother of Joel, was one of David's mighty men.

H5416G.name: Nathan
H5416G.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H5416G.brief: Son of David and Bathsheba, ancestor of Jesus.
H5416G.short: Nathan, a son of David and Bathsheba, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ.

H5416H.name: Nathan
H5416H.desc: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
H5416H.brief: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.
H5416H.short: Nathan, a prophet of God, served during the reigns of David and Solomon, offering guidance, confronting David's sin, and supporting Solomon's accession to the throne.

H5416L.name: Nathan
H5416L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5416L.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile.
H5416L.short: Nathan is listed among the Israelites who had married foreign women during the Exile and pledged to put them away.

H5416K.name: Nathan
H5416K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5416K.brief: A leader summoned by Ezra to help teach the Law.
H5416K.short: Nathan, along with other leaders, was summoned by Ezra to assist in teaching the Law to the people.

H5419.name: Nathan-melech
H5419.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5419.brief: A court official during King Josiah's reign.
H5419.short: Nathan-melech was a court official who had living quarters near the entrance of the temple during King Josiah's reign.

H5417I.name: Nethanel
H5417I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5417I.short: Nethanel was a priest who blew trumpets before the ark of God.

H5417H.name: Nethanel
H5417H.desc: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
H5417H.short: Nethanel was a son of Jesse and brother of King David.

H5417J.name: Nethanel
H5417J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5417J.short: Nethanel was a scribe who helped divide the priests into their divisions during David's reign.

H5417K.name: Nethanel
H5417K.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H5417K.short: Nethanel was one of the sons of Obed-Edom, the Levite.

H5417L.name: Nethanel
H5417L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5417L.short: Nethanel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

H5417M.name: Nethanel
H5417M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5417M.short: Nethanel was a Levite leader who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.

H5417N.name: Nethanel
H5417N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5417N.short: Nethanel was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the Exile.

H5417O.name: Nethanel
H5417O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5417O.short: Nethanel was a priest in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H5417P.name: Nethanel
H5417P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5417P.short: Nethanel was a musician who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H5417G.name: Nethanel
H5417G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5417G.short: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness wanderings.

H5418H.name: Nethaniah
H5418H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5418H.brief: Musician in David's time, descended from Asaph
H5418H.short: Nethaniah was a musician in David's time, brother of Asharelah (or 'Asarelah').

H5418I.name: Nethaniah
H5418I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5418I.short: Nethaniah was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

H5418G.name: Nethaniah
H5418G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5418G.short: Nethaniah was the father of Ishmael, the assassin of Gedaliah the governor.

H5418J.name: Nethaniah
H5418J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5418J.short: Nethaniah was the father of Jehudi, an official in King Jehoiakim's court.

H5454.name: Sabtah
H5454.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5454.brief: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham
H5454.short: Sabtah (or Sabta) was a son of Cush and a grandson of Ham, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H5455.name: Sabteca
H5455.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5455.brief: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham
H5455.short: Sabteca was a son of Cush and a grandson of Ham, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H5434G.name: Seba
H5434G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5434G.brief: Son of Cush, brother of Raamah
H5434G.short: Seba was a son of Cush and brother of Raamah.

H5444.name: Sibbecai
H5444.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H5444.brief: One of David's mighty men, a Hushathite.
H5444.short: Sibbecai (or Mebunnai) was one of David's mighty men, a Hushathite who fought valiantly in David's battles.

H5471.name: So
H5471.desc: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5471.brief: Egyptian pharaoh to whom King Hoshea sent messengers.
H5471.short: So was an Egyptian pharaoh to whom King Hoshea of Israel sent messengers, likely seeking an alliance against Assyria.

H5476.name: Sodi
H5476.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5476.brief: Father of the Zebulunite spy Gaddiel.
H5476.short: Sodi was the father of Gaddiel, the man chosen from the tribe of Zebulun to spy out the land of Canaan.

H5479.name: Sotai
H5479.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5479.brief: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
H5479.short: Sotai was the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who were among the exiles that returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H5477.name: Suah
H5477.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5477.brief: Son of Zophah, from the tribe of Asher
H5477.short: Suah, a descendant of Asher mentioned in a genealogy.

H5485.name: Susi
H5485.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5485.brief: Father of the Manassite spy Gaddi
H5485.short: Susi was the father of Gaddi, the spy from the tribe of Manasseh.

H5483B.name: Horse Gate
H5483B.brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall near the temple
H5483B.short: The Horse Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall near the temple.

H5488G.name: Red Sea
H5488G.brief: Sea crossed by Israelites in the Exodus
H5488G.short: The Red Sea was the body of water miraculously crossed by the Israelites in their escape from Egypt (<ref="Exo. 13:18; 15:4">Exo. 13:18; 15:4</ref>).
H5488G.meaning: in Hebrew Yam Suph, “Sea of Reeds”

H5434H.name: Seba
H5434H.brief: Kingdom mentioned in prophetic and poetic texts
H5434H.short: Seba was a kingdom mentioned in prophetic and poetic texts, often in the context of bringing gifts to God (<ref="Psa. 72:10; Isa. 43:3">Psa. 72:10; Isa. 43:3</ref>).

H5453.name: Sibraim
H5453.brief: Landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land
H5453.short: Sibraim was a place mentioned by Ezekiel as a landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land, between the territory of Damascus and that of Hamath (<ref="Ezek. 47:16">Ezek. 47:16</ref>).

H5467.name: Sodom
H5467.brief: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins
H5467.short: Sodom, a notoriously wicked city destroyed by God along with Gomorrah for their grave sins (<ref="Gen. 19:24-25">Gen. 19:24-25</ref>).

H5489.name: Suph
H5489.brief: Place near where Moses spoke to Israel
H5489.short: Suph, a place near the wilderness where Moses spoke to the Israelites (<ref="Deut. 1:1">Deut. 1:1</ref>).

H5492B.name: Suphah
H5492B.brief: Place mentioned in the Book of the Wars of the Lord
H5492B.short: Suphah, a place mentioned in the Book of the Wars of the Lord (<ref="Num. 21:14">Num. 21:14</ref>).

H5495.name: Sur
H5495.brief: Gate of the temple in Jerusalem
H5495.short: Sur, a gate of the temple in Jerusalem, possibly referring to the Foundation Gate (<ref="2Kgs. 11:6">2Kgs. 11:6</ref>).

H5482.name: Syene
H5482.brief: Southern border of Egypt, modern-day Aswan
H5482.short: Syene, the southern border of Egypt, mentioned in prophecies about Egypt's destruction (<ref="Ezek. 29:10; 30:6">Ezek. 29:10; 30:6</ref>).
